name: VHS Cassette

steps.caption: Bottom half: floor plates, tied together by the tiles and the first wall course
Silver screw heads sit in the floor: five of them, like the real thing
Round rims around the two reel drive holes
Walls
Front corners: a hole through each side for the tape-end light path, and the grey door release button on the right
Tape path: backing bricks with side studs, silver guide pins, white rollers
Cap the front beam
Stretch the tape across the mouth
Top course: ties the walls, corners and front beam together
Door hinge mounts: plates with studs on the side
Hinge bases, pushed onto the side studs
The bottom half
Dust door, built flat: start with a 2 x 6 plate
Add plates and tie them with a tile
Complete the plate row
Smooth outer face
Lower edge of the door
Top edge: fillers that swing up with the door
Second layer of fillers
Hinge tops
Click the dust door onto its two hinges
Top half, built face up: plates first
Smoked window: see-through plates, and black holders over the reel hubs
Window glass tiles
White face label recess
Moulded arrows pointing to the door
Grip ridges on the front corners
Turn the top half over and push in the two reel pins
Hub core: the pin runs through its opening
Lower flange from four quarter circles
Tape wound on the reel
Hub with its drive teeth
Slide the full supply reel onto its pin
Hub core: the pin runs through its opening
Lower flange from four quarter circles
Just a few turns of tape left, so the flange shows
Hub with its drive teeth
Slide the nearly empty take-up reel onto its pin
Lower the top half, reels and all, onto the bottom half
